title: Lockman Rescues a Dog Locked in a Car
description: A pup locked in a hot car in San Francisco? The Lockman signal lights up the sky and Lockman flies in to open the door safely, no damage. Locked out? Call (415) 806-7343.

title: Lockman at Pier 39 and Chinatown
description: From the sea lions at Pier 39 to the lanterns of Chinatown, Lockman keeps San Francisco locked down tight.
